english.legislation: Contrary to section 23 of the Regulation of Railways Act 1868.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being on/passing upon the railway having received warning not to go/pass thereon
by an agent/servant of the railway company that works the railway

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) A railway station platform is not part of the railway under this section, but consider: section 16, of the Railways Regulation Act 1840 - trespass on the railway and refuse to quit or section 55, of the British Transport Commission Act 1949 - trespass upon railway lines and lands in proximity.
(ii) A bone fide claim to be acting in exercise of a public right of way which was established before the railway amounts to a defence. (Cole v Miles 1988 60 LT 145) and (Arnold v Morgan 1911 2 KB 314).
